chapters.title: In Search of Hope
chapters.goal: Play as [[Sylvando]] and recruit a travelling troupe on the road from Gondolia to Hotto, ending his interlude.

steps.t: Note that only the items [[Sylvando]] carried are usable.
Skip the shops, since your forged gear beats their stock.
Talk to the man standing by the water at the stage in the north of Gondolia.
Talk to the Beastly Boys at the stall just left of the town entrance.
Beat the Beastly Boys, hitting the left one first because he raises their attack.
Return the knapsack to the man by the water.
Leave for the Gallopolis Region, ignoring the way to Grotta della Fonte.
In the Laguna di Gondolia cave, talk to the cow beside it.
Bring the milk to the tired priest so he joins.
Go to the peninsula south of Gallopolis.
Fight the Vicious [[Fandangow]] group there for the knight.
Lean on the priest's [[Midheal]] if their dance costs turns.
If the [[Cactolotl]] surfaces on that peninsula, walk away; it is far stronger than your group.
In Gallopolis, talk to the juggler in the southeastern tavern.
Pick the red ball.
Talk to the drummer outside the church.
Cheer up Margarita at the stables north of him.
Keep the horse poo she gives you.
Talk to the man outside the circus tent.
Watch the show.
Save.
Head out to the Hotto Steppe.
Give the horse poo to the man with the plant monster north of the Slime so he joins.
Rest at the camp past the north bridge.
Save at the camp.
Fight the [[Gigantes]] guarding the bridge to the east.
Put the [[Gigantes]] to sleep with the priest's sermon.
Heal with [[Hustle Dance]] after Crackerwhack, which hits everyone for around 80.
Enter Hotto to end the interlude; if you missed a recruit, the best outfit can still be earned later.

chapters.title: Jade Journeys Forth
chapters.goal: Play as [[Jade]] through Booga's Limboo gauntlet and defeat [[Boodica]].

steps.t: Skip the Vicious [[Great Sabrecat]] packs outside Octagonia; you can fill their entries later.
Save at the Goddess statue.
Climb to the third level to meet [[Booga]].
If lost, use the path beside the monster with the pink bubble.
In the Limboo cells, smash the southeastern cell pots for a [[Rockbomb Shard]].
Smash the north-central cell pots for a [[Special Medicine]].
Save with the big guy in the northeastern cell.
Enter the southwestern cell to continue.
Put the prisoner's free items into [[Jade]]'s inventory.
Talk to the knight guarding the exit to start the gauntlet.
In the first fight, use [[Party Pooper]] on all three attackers; the [[Hare-Raising Suit]] revives you, but winning gives experience.
In the second fight, kill the Boodiful Wizards first, since their [[Frizzle]] deals 60 or more.
In the third fight, wipe out one pair quickly so they cannot pep up for Just Claws.
Against [[Boodica]], use [[Multithrust]] on her two hands (about 350 HP each) before anything else.
Then wear [[Boodica]] down (about 1600 HP) while [[Sinderella]] heals with [[Midheal]] and powers you up with [[Oomph]].

get: [[Special Medicine]] x3, [[Magic Water]], [[Rockbomb Shard]] - from a prisoner on the walk to the gauntlet

chapters.title: Erik's New Acquaintance
chapters.goal: Break [[Erik]] out of the Rock of Wrong with a Healslime ally and defeat [[Indignus]].

steps.t: Leave the cell.
Take the southeast exit.
Open the chest for a [[Steel Broadsword]].
Crawl through the gap.
Listen at the wall crack to learn the key sits in the middle chest.
At the five-chest dead end, beat the [[Cannibox]] chests in the northwest and southeast for a [[Seed of Skill]] each.
Open the middle chest for the [[Hideout Key]], plus the southwest and northeast chests for gear.
Unlock the north door in the first room.
Keep north, following the upper ledge to the crawl hole into the Ancient Ruins.
Ride the ornate platform across the chasm.
Save at the statue, which also refills HP and MP.
Clear the three monster groups at the dead lift.
Watch for [[Bobonga]] fire breath (around 70) and [[Professaurus]] [[Frizzle]] there.
Ride the powered lift.
Open the ledge chests for a [[Seed of Deftness]] and an [[Agility Ring]].
In the Great Hall, climb the western wooden platform for the [[Disturbin' Turban]] chest.
Exit north.
Defeat the Vicious [[Chihuawyrm]] first.
Defeat the [[Skelegon]] next.
Defeat the [[Dragon Rider]] last.
Fight [[Indignus]]; your boosted regeneration makes losing unlikely, so pair [[Divide]] with ailment skills for big damage.

get: [[Seed of Skill]] x2 - Canniboxes in the five-chest room
[[Agility Ring]] - ledge chest past the big lift

chapters.title: Lord Robert and the Kingdom of Dreams
chapters.goal: Play as [[Rab]] through a dream of old Dundrasil, help its people, and face [[Grand Master Pang]].

steps.t: Chase the bunny girl.
Talk to the bunny girl to move to old Dundrasil.
Go to the throne room.
Sit on the left throne.
Answer yes when asked.
Search the cabinets in the room north of the throne room for a [[Sage's Elixir]].
Talk to Irwin outside the throne room.
Sit on the throne.
Answer the audiences however you like.
Answer the trivia man by the saving priest with True, False, True, False, True for a [[Seed of Magic]].
Take the western garden guard's posy to any red-haired person in green for a [[Pretty Betsy]].
Bring the well-dressed man in the east middle-floor room any pungent item (the pie or a plant) for a [[Seed of Strength]].
Talk to Irwin in the middle-floor garden.
Check the throne-room cupboards for a [[Dieamend]].
Follow the bunny girl to the southern stairs.
Smash the corner pots in the room below for [[Wakerobin]]s.
Talk to the young [[Luminary]] at each stop.
Answer the bunny girl yes twice.
Go up through the door.
Fight [[Grand Master Pang]] (losing still lets the story continue).
Put her to sleep with [[Snooze]].
Attack with [[Zammle]].
Heal with [[Moreheal]].
Kill her [[Tantamount]] (about 320 HP) fast.
Defend after her second charge to soften the 11-hit attack.

get: [[Seed of Magic]] - trivia man near the saving priest
[[Seed of Strength]] - pepper errand, east middle-floor room
[[Pretty Betsy]] - posy errand

chapters.title: Dawn of a New World
chapters.goal: Wake in Nautica, reach The Last Bastion, and free Heliodor Castle from [[Tyriant]] with [[Hendrik]].

level.t: The [[Luminary]] at level 33 or higher should handle the Heliodorian Foothills monsters.

steps.t: Swim around Nautica before seeing the Queen; chests hold a [[Seed of Skill]], [[Elfin Elixir]], [[Zombiesbane]] and a mini medal north of the item shop.
Talk to Queen Marina in the Palace.
Touch the pearl.
Grab the juicy prawn in the centre of town.
On the Emerald Coast, rest at the camp to re-register Zoom.
Go through Cobblestone Falls.
In The Last Bastion, climb the ladder at the far west past the weapon shop for a 3000G chest.
Meet the King in the Royal Tent.
Join [[Hendrik]] at the north barricade.
Against the [[Headless Honcho]], kill the [[Vicious Grim Gryphon]] first.
Clear the escorts with [[Boom]] and [[Kasnooze]].
Then hit the Honcho (about 690 HP) with [[Unbridled Blade]], keeping HP above 150.
Take the [[Sewer Key]] from the King.
Climb the northwest vine in the Heliodorian Foothills to the secret sewer entrance.
If you want revenge on the [[Black Dragon]], take the north path in the sewers.
Beat the [[Black Dragon]] (about 1050 HP) with [[Unbridled Blade]].
In Heliodor Castle, search Jasper's Quarters for a [[Platinum Sword]] and [[The Devil's in the Details]].
Move the southern shelves in the storage room past the kitchen to reach the bedchambers and their recipe books.
Fight [[Tyriant]].
Kill each Shadow (about 280 HP) with [[Unbridled Blade]].
Use magic during Sword Stance.
Keep HP above 150.
Zoom to The Last Bastion.
Go down the western stairs in the Cobblestone Tor caverns for [[Footwear of the Rich and Famous]].
Talk to the King for the [[Shield of Heliodor]].
Save at the church.
Set out for the Manglegrove.

get: [[The Devil's in the Details]] - Jasper's Quarters bookshelf, Heliodor Castle
[[A Recipe Book of Regal Regalia]] - King's Bedchamber bookshelf
[[Little Lifesavers]] - Queen's Bedchamber chest
[[Footwear of the Rich and Famous]] - Cobblestone Tor caverns, end of western stairs
[[Platinum Sword]] - Jasper's Quarters chest
[[Shield of Heliodor]] - from the King after Heliodor is freed

chapters.title: Journey to Angri-La
chapters.goal: Climb Mount Pang Lai to Angri-La, rescue the hermit at the summit, and win [[Rab]] back by mastering [[Quadraslash]].

steps.t: In the Manglegrove, take the vine down to the southwest.
Open the chest to the north for a mini medal.
At the Manglegrove camp, forge a [[King Axe]] for [[Hendrik]] (or upgrade his axe) and [[Magic Armour]] at +3.
Rework the [[Shield of Heliodor]] to +3.
Forge a [[Shield-Bearer]].
Equip the Shield-Bearer on [[Hendrik]].
Cross to the Costa Valor.
Head north into Mount Pang Lai, ignoring the landslide.
In the Base Cave, beat a glittering [[Dragon Rider]].
Fly the [[Dragon Rider]] across the water to the [[Mythril Ore]] spots.
On the Slopes, open the chest past the bridge for [[More Dragony Designs]].
Open the chest east of town for a [[Staff of Antimagic]].
In Angri-La, buy [[Dragon Hide]]s and [[Dragon Horn]]s at the item shop.
If you lacked materials for the [[King Axe]], buy an [[Ice Axe]].
Meet the High Lama in the High Hall.
Follow the High Lama east to the Field of Discipline.
Next morning, accept [[Understanding Angri-La]] near the priest.
Finish a [[Boreal Serpent]] with [[Blaze of Glory]] for a [[Mystic]].
In the Summit Tunnel, fly a [[Dragon Rider]] to the northwest lake island for a [[Sorcerer's Ring]].
At the summit camp, forge the [[Wyrmfang]] for the [[Luminary]].
Rework the [[Ice Axe]] if you bought one.
Rest at the camp.
Save.
Spar with [[Rab]] by casting [[Quadraslash]] every turn; the aim is to power it up, not to beat him.
Defend the turn after [[Rab]] prepares himself to soften [[Pearly Gates]].
Use [[Moreheal]] if HP drops below 150.
Leave the Wheel of Harma at the Field of Discipline alone until your party is around level 50.

get: [[More Dragony Designs]] - Mount Pang Lai Slopes, chest past the bridge
[[Staff of Antimagic]] - Mount Pang Lai Slopes, east of town
[[Sorcerer's Ring]] - Summit Tunnel lake island
[[Mystic]] - [[Understanding Angri-La]] reward
[[Ethereal Stone]] - Angri-La inn chest

chapters.title: Reuniting with Sylvando
chapters.goal: Pick up L'Academie quests, defeat [[Avarith]] at Phnom Nonh, and get [[Sylvando]] and the ship back in Puerto Valor.

level.t: Be around level 36 for the Champs Sauvage.

steps.t: Zoom to the Mount Pang Lai campsite.
Return to the Costa Valor.
Take the new passage west into the Champs Sauvage.
Mount a glittering [[Honeyhead Horknight]] near L'Academie.
Fly over the lake to a chest with a [[Sunny Citrine]].
Accept [[Madame Labouche's Life Lesson]] from the Lips outside L'Academie; it needs 330 Charm.
Inside, accept [[A Delayed Diploma]].
Accept [[A Fragrant Fille]].
At night in the northeast classroom, accept [[One Last Request]].
Trade your mini medals with the Headmaster for [[Spiked Armour]] and the [[Miracle Sword]].
Accept [[A Right Riddle]] in the Bibliotheque.
Equip a [[Steel Broadsword]], forging one if needed, to pass the first riddle.
Cross the large bridge south toward Phnom Nonh and escort Da home with the troupe.
In Phnom Nonh, accept [[Worth Its Salt]].
Rest at the inn.
Register the nearby camp.
Swap the [[Mardi Garb]] for real armour to raise defence.
Go south to the Promontory Cave.
Fight [[Avarith]] (about 2200 HP).
Have [[Rab]] cast [[Antimagic]] to stop [[Kasizz]].
Heal with [[Staff of Salvation]] and [[Right as Rain]].
Lower her defence with [[Helm Splitter]].
Hit with [[Unbridled Blade]].
Cast [[Multiheal]] whenever your spells are unsealed.
Zoom back.
Meet [[Sylvando]] on the hill.
Take the Costa Valor east tunnel to Puerto Valor.
Before leaving Don Rodrigo's house, take [[Platinum Plating]] from the bookshelf.
Take a [[Finessence]] from the right wardrobe.
Accept [[When Knight Falls]] near the entrance.
Buy [[The Mothmask Prophecies]] at the casino, since it is a one-time prize.

get: [[Spiked Armour]], [[Miracle Sword]] - mini medal rewards at L'Academie
[[Platinum Plating]] - Don Rodrigo's bookshelf, Puerto Valor
[[Finessence]] - Don Rodrigo's right wardrobe
[[The Mothmask Prophecies]] - Puerto Valor casino prize
[[Sunny Citrine]] - Champs Sauvage lake chest, needs a mount

chapters.title: Reuniting with Jade
chapters.goal: Free King Irwin in Dundrasil, then beat [[Jinxed Jade]] and [[Booga]] in Octagonia to win back [[Jade]] and [[Lorelei's Harp]].

steps.t: Board the ship in the Costa Valor.
Sail northwest to the Zwaardsrust Region, leaving Gondolia for later.
Find the small gravestone in the hay fields southeast of the Warrior's Rest Inn.
Return to the girl from Quest 32 for a [[Chronocrystal]].
Rework the [[Mardi Garb]] to +3 to hit 330 Charm.
Finish [[Madame Labouche's Life Lesson]] for [[Glam Gear for Go-Getters]].
Register the Dundrasil Region camp.
Switch to night.
Ride a glittering [[Headless Horseman]] for the mount trophy.
Enter the castle ruins through the well.
Follow [[Rab]]'s secret passage to the [[Sage's Elixir]] chest at the intersection.
Fight the [[Restless Knight]] (about 2400 HP).
Have [[Rab]] cast [[Blunt]] and [[Sap]].
Have [[Rab]] lift curses.
Keep [[Blunt]] on the knight if he peps up.
Have [[Sylvando]] use [[Oomph]] on the [[Luminary]].
Hit with [[Unbridled Blade]] for over 600 each.
In past Dundrasil, follow the King into the tunnels.
Use [[Quadraslash]] on the monster group.
Fight the [[Gloomnivore]] (about 2750 HP).
Use [[Blunt]] on its attack.
Paralyse it with [[Parallax]].
Heal with [[Hustle Dance]].
In Octagonia's casino, take the 2000 free tokens.
Spend your winnings on [[Love Potion]]s, the only useful prize.
Load MP restoring items on [[Rab]], the [[Luminary]] and [[Sylvando]].
Give the Dracky by the stairs a [[Love Potion]] to enter the VIP area.
Fight [[Jinxed Jade]] (about 1800 HP).
Cast [[Sap]] on her.
Give the [[Luminary]] [[Oomphle]] for [[Unbridled Blade]].
Keep HP high against Sexy Beam.
Fight [[Booga]] right after (about 3200 HP).
Use [[Sobering Slap]] on charmed allies.
Keep [[Blunt]] and [[Sap]] on him.
Use MP items freely.
If you want the [[Vest for Success]], take [[Richie's Rock-Hard Roulette Challenge]].
Bet on 12 and 14 once the jackpot bunny hints at a win.

get: [[Glam Gear for Go-Getters]] - [[Madame Labouche's Life Lesson]] reward
[[Chronocrystal]] - [[One Last Request]] reward
[[Lorelei's Harp]] - regained after [[Booga]]
[[Imp Knife]] - Octagonia casino prize, not found elsewhere
[[Vest for Success]] - [[Richie's Rock-Hard Roulette Challenge]] reward

chapters.title: Reuniting with Erik
chapters.goal: Beat [[Alizarin]] at sea, reach Sniflheim, and defeat [[Gyldygga]] in the Gyldenhal to restore [[Erik]].

level.t: Be around level 42 to 43 by the Gyldenhal boss.

steps.t: Sail through the Valor-Sauvage Channel.
Stop at The Strand to register it for Zoom.
At Insula Algarum, ride a [[Dragon Rider]] to the hidden chests, including an [[Agate of Evolution]] on a small island.
In Lonalulu, accept [[Soothing Seaweed]].
Accept [[My Kingdom for Some Kanaloamari]].
Accept [[The Measure of a Man]].
If [[My Kingdom for Some Kanaloamari]] or [[The Measure of a Man]] is missing, learn [[Flame Slash]] and [[Unbridled Blade]].
Get the [[Dulcet Dulse]] from the merman on the Insula Algarum bridge.
Hand the [[Dulcet Dulse]] in at Lonalulu for [[Molten Globules]].
Sail far north of Sniflheim to the Vortex of Light to trigger the [[Alizarin]] fight.
Against [[Alizarin]] (about 4800 HP), have [[Jade]] use [[Re-Vamp]] twice then [[Multithrust]].
Have [[Hendrik]] use [[Kabuff]] and [[Helm Splitter]] in the same fight.
Stay fully healed during Crimson Mist and counter his slowdown; [[Sylvando]] heals with [[Hustle Dance]] or casts [[Oomphle]] on the [[Luminary]].
In Sniflheim, see Queen Frysabel.
Visit the priest's back room.
Fight the golden monsters in town, focusing the [[Gyldenbritches]].
Sail to the Viking Hideout.
Clear the Gyldennauts with [[Quadraslash]].
Touch the Yggdrasil root to restore [[Erik]].
Rebuild [[Erik]] with [[Cobra Strike]], [[Victimiser]], dual-wielding and [[Divide]].
Open the chest east of the shelter for [[Snowfield Styles]].
Enter the Gyldenhal.
In the Gyldenhal, take [[Gilt Gear]] on Level 2.
Avoid the slot machines that are Penny Pinchers in disguise.
Fight [[Gyldygga]] (about 3600 HP).
Use [[Blunt]] on her after she uses [[Oomphle]].
Keep [[Hendrik]] as backup healer in case gold traps your main one.
Buy a [[Paladin's Lance]] for [[Jade]].
Find the diploma student upstairs in the weapon shop.
Zoom back to L'Academie to complete the quest.

get: [[Agate of Evolution]] - Insula Algarum island chest, needs a mount
[[Snowfield Styles]] - Viking Hideout, east of the shelter
[[Gilt Gear]] - Gyldenhal Level 2 chest
[[Corsair's Cap]] - from beating [[Gyldygga]]
[[Gear that Glitters]] - [[A Delayed Diploma]] reward
[[Deft Dagger]] - mini medal reward at L'Academie

chapters.title: Reuniting with the Twins
chapters.goal: Clear the open side quests, defeat the [[Auroral Serpent]] to rejoin [[Serena]], and gain the skies with Cetacea.

level.t: Be around level 44 before the [[Auroral Serpent]].

steps.t: Take the Vortex of Light near Zwaardsrust to Nautica.
Accept [[Marking a Momentous Occasion]] in Nautica.
Accept [[Justice is Brined]] in Nautica.
Pep up the [[Luminary]], [[Hendrik]] and [[Sylvando]].
Use [[Arise]] on the [[Knight Aberrant]] in The Eerie Eyrie for a [[Metal Slime Shield]].
On Insula Incognita, finish a [[Night Clubber]] with [[Buff-Buff]] once its name turns orange.
Claim a [[Venus' Tear]] in Lonalulu.
Collect the [[Kanono Cannon]] from the cannon lady in the house north of Lonalulu's item shop.
In the northern seas, finish a [[Tentacular]] with [[Tempered Tantrum]] for the [[Kanaloamari]].
Trade the [[Kanaloamari]] in Lonalulu for a [[Pentarang]].
Open the chest in the Insula Occidentalis cabin for the [[Sealicitor's Statutes]].
In Nautica, give the turtle the [[Kanono Cannon]].
Give the Courthouse mermaid the notes for [[Secrets of the Sunken Spirit]] and a [[Sovereign Seal]].
Accept [[A Ballad of Bravery]] at the Warrior's Rest Inn.
Bring back [[Luter's Opus]] from the southwest Dundrasil hut.
In The Snaerfelt, accept [[A Dish Served Cold]].
Fight [[Killing Machine]]s at the Frozen Fjord until a [[Type G0]] appears.
Equip any paralysis protection.
Rest at the camp.
Save at the camp.
Head past the Frozen Fjord toward Arboria.
Fight the [[Auroral Serpent]] (about 4900 HP).
Heal every round.
Cure paralysis with [[Sylvando]]'s [[Tingle]].
Deal damage with [[Sap]], [[Oomphle]]-boosted [[Unbridled Blade]], and [[Jade]]'s double [[Re-Vamp]] into [[Multithrust]]; [[Hendrik]] casts [[Kabuff]].
Give the reborn [[Serena]] [[Enchanting Echo]] first.
Give her [[Antimagic]] next to open [[Grace of the Goddess]].
After getting the [[Calamus Flute]], accept [[A Long-Lost Literary Love]] in Arboria.
Fly to each Whale Way Station for loot.

get: [[Secrets of the Sunken Spirit]] - [[Marking a Momentous Occasion]] reward
[[Fine Fashions for Philosophers]] - [[A Ballad of Bravery]] reward
[[Metal Slime Armour]] - [[A Dish Served Cold]] reward
[[An Album of Imperial Attire]] - Sniflheim Whale Way Station, southwest chest
[[An Earring for Every Element]] - Champs Sauvage Whale Way Station, north chest
[[Even More Dragony Designs]] - Hotto Steppe northern Whale Way Station, behind the locked door

chapters.title: Forging the Sword of Legend
chapters.goal: Gather the [[Orichalcum]], the [[Forging Hammer]] and Hotto's forge to create the [[Sword of Light]].

steps.t: At Havens Above, take the [[Guiding Light]] in the Temple of Dawn.
Fly to The Battleground.
Use the [[Guiding Light]] on the object ahead.
Kill each [[Pandora's Box]] chest quickly with your strongest attacks before it casts [[Kathwack]]; each drops a [[Seed of Skill]].
Mount a [[Dragooner]] in the central shaft to reach the caves that need flight.
At the camp near the bottom of the shaft, forge an [[Ogre Shield]] for [[Hendrik]] and [[Titan Belt]]s for physical attackers.
Open the eastern B9 chest for [[Sacred Styles for Saintly Ladies]].
On B6, fly to the western chest for [[Brace Yourself]].
Follow the long north path to the Overlooked Cavern.
Take the [[Orichalcum]].
In Gondolia, haggle between the brothers to buy [[Hendrik's Armour]] for 10000G.
Buy a [[Fizzle Foil]].
At the Grotta della Fonte camp, forge the [[Goddess's Tiara]] and [[Saintess Dress]] for [[Serena]], plus [[Mighty Armlet]]s and [[Brainy Bracer]]s.
Clear [[Worth Its Salt]], [[A Right Riddle]] (equip the [[Fizzle Foil]]), [[The Search for the Sage's Stone]] and [[A Rose Arose Where No Rose Grows]].
After the Celestial Sands event, talk to the Sultan in the Gallopolis throne room twice for the [[Forging Hammer]].
At the Hotto Steppe camp, forge a [[Metal Gooreatsword]] for the [[Luminary]].
When [[Tatsunaga]] attacks Hotto, have [[Hendrik]] cast [[Kabuff]].
Attack with [[Unbridled Blade]] and [[Multithrust]].
Watch for [[Tatsunaga]]'s desperate attacks, which can top 200.
In Mount Huji, fight [[Tatsunaga]] (about 2400 HP).
Keep [[Kabuff]] up.
Use double [[Re-Vamp]] on [[Jade]].
Cast [[Oomphle]] on the [[Luminary]].
Get the [[Crucible Key]] from Miko's maid.
Unlock the far north door of Mount Huji.
Present the [[Guiding Light]].

get: [[An Encyclopaedia of Expert Equipment]] - The Battleground B3, first north cave
[[Sacred Styles for Saintly Ladies]] - The Battleground B9, east chest
[[Brace Yourself]] - The Battleground B6, needs a [[Dragooner]]
[[Making the Most of Mythril]] - [[The Search for the Sage's Stone]] reward
[[Things to Do with Metal Goo]] - [[A Long-Lost Literary Love]] reward
[[Hendrik's Armour]] - Gondolia merchant, 10000G

chapters.title: The Fortress of Fear
chapters.goal: Storm the Fortress of Fear, forge the best Act II gear inside, and defeat Mordegon to end Act II.

level.t: Reach at least level 50 inside the fortress, and be around level 55 before the final battle.

steps.t: Heal fully at an inn or camp.
Use the [[Calamus Flute]] to fly to the Fortress of Fear.
Fight [[Indignus]] (about 3500 HP).
Cast [[Sap]] on him.
Cure Gigathrow paralysis with [[Tingle]] at once.
Keep HP above half.
Since he strips buffs, keep up steady damage with [[Jade]]'s [[Multithrust]] or [[Multifeet]] and an [[Oomphle]]d [[Unbridled Blade]] rather than rebuffing.
Save at the Goddess Statue in the corner.
Beat the [[Dark Dullahan]]s inside the door.
Open the Level 1 west chest for [[Pride of the Valkyries]].
Forge [[Pride of the Valkyries]] at a camp for [[Jade]].
Take [[General Directives]] from the Level 3 west chest.
Open the shortcut.
Forge [[Hendrik]]'s gear.
On the Level 3 exterior, search behind the [[Jerkules]] for [[In Fine Fettle with Liquid Metal]].
After breaking the central crystals, forge the [[Liquid Metal Gooreatsword]], [[Liquid Metal Spear]] and [[Liquid Metal Armour]] for the [[Luminary]].
Hit the Level 4 switches.
Open the north door on Level 1 for the [[Meteorite Bracer]].
Give the [[Meteorite Bracer]] to your healer.
Save at the outside Goddess Statue.
Grab the [[Sage's Elixir]] chest past the raised platforms.
Cross the bridge.
Fight [[Jasper Unbound]] (about 3600 HP).
Have [[Hendrik]] cast [[Kabuff]] so Jasper wastes turns removing it.
Ignore Jasper's summons.
Attack Jasper with [[Sword Dance]] or [[Unbridled Blade]] plus [[Multifeet]].
Keep one healer on duty with HP above half.
Stock MP items and [[Yggdrasil Leaf]]s.
Fight [[Mordegon, Lord of Shadows]] (about 5500 HP).
Kill the [[Shadow of Shadows]] before it casts [[Kabuff]].
Against [[Mordragon]], kill [[Mordragon's tail]] first so it cannot revive him with [[Kazing]].
Use [[Magic Barrier]].
Swap tired party members in.

get: [[Pride of the Valkyries]] - Level 1 west chest, best Act II armour for [[Jade]]
[[General Directives]] - Level 3 west chest, best Act II gear for [[Hendrik]]
[[In Fine Fettle with Liquid Metal]] - Level 3 exterior, behind the [[Jerkules]]
[[Meteorite Bracer]] - Level 1, behind the locked north door
[[Liquid Metal Jacket]] - Level 1 west, under the stairs
